mapper.select: SELECT stock FROM book WHERE id = #{bookId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM stock_record sr LEFT JOIN book b ON sr.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN stock_batch sb ON sr.batch_id = sb.id LEFT JOIN user u ON sr.operator_id = u.id WHERE sr.id = #{id}
